correctness.rationale: PASS. The prior nonequivariant wedge-of-S^2 theorem supplies homology concentration. From graph domination condition every simplex has 1 or 2 arbitrary edges, or 3 edges forming C3/P4, or 4 edges forming C4, with no larger simplices; orientation signs under S_n give local C1/C2/C3 characters (not unsigned permutation counts). Direct local S4 character traces for disjoint pairs, P4 and C4 are respectively (3,1,-1,0,-1), (12,0,-4,0,0) and (3,1,-1,0,-1). Euler–Poincare in the rational representation ring gives h_(n-2)h2 - h_(n-3)s_(2,1)+2h_(n-4)s_(2,1,1)-h_n; Pieri horizontal strips yield the four claimed stable Specht constituents, and separate n4/n5 cases. Independent hook-length dimension check n4..12 matches wedge Betti polynomial; finite dimensions alone do NOT certify the full character. Hypotheses n>=4, rational S_n module only.
